study: Unchanged archived raw MASK candidates on the existing 17 compiled-treatment fixtures
status_at_freeze: Existing 3-primary results known; expanded raw17 outcomes not yet executed. Same source data and no new inference or human approval.
execution: Original raw lambda code executed unchanged with real pandas, including NaN and pd.NA; no Stage4 or null-preserving wrapper, no normalization. Prior raw run used None-only notna stub. Only the 8 previously reviewed exact hashes and the existing AST validator can execute.

scoring.nonmissing_denominator: 14 per candidate: 12 strings containing digits plus empty string and abc. Also report the 12 digit-bearing strings separately.
scoring.missing_denominator: 3 per candidate (None,float NaN,pd.NA); success means output remains missing, not literal string or mask. Compiled saved null only establishes semantic missingness, not exact subtype.
scoring.digit_positions: Unicode str.isdigit positions, including fullwidth digits; separators are not digits.
scoring.protection: If input contains digits, allow complete nonempty suppression using the original mask alphabet *#Xx●•. Otherwise output must be same length and each character unchanged or replaced by a mask character; conceal the last min(3,n) numeric positions OR, when n>3, the three numeric positions immediately preceding the final digit. No digit-bearing input is accepted unchanged.
scoring.zero_digit_policy: Empty and no-digit strings must remain unchanged; this is the existing compiled boundary behavior, a separate preservation contract rather than a legal masking obligation.
scoring.parameter_contract: Record missing/empty parameters independently of output quality; output success is not human approval or legal applicability.

runtime.python: Python interpreter with pandas 3.0.6; exact tested version in result runtime

reproduction: Run first and repeat with deterministic JSON outputs, then independent checker with no imports of this runner or product.
limits: Only existing candidates and17authoredinputs; no LLM, participants, legal certification, product/manuscript/git mutations.

packaging.status: Post-result portable packaging of an already completed frozen protocol. This is not a new preregistration.
packaging.changes: Source locations made repository-relative; interpreter location made environment-independent. Candidate code, fixtures and scoring are unchanged.
packaging.source_resolution: source_hashes are original repository-relative provenance only; runtime_hashes address files relative to this package.
packaging.restricted_source_handling: Full policy corpus and production records are not distributed or required at runtime. Only source hashes remain as provenance; source_binding_summary.json records local independent binding before publication. Minimal AST validator and fixture definition are exact source extractions.
